title: UI: Fix visual and console-error bugs in Dag list and details
body: Fix a bunch of various UI bugs. - console errors due to duplicate gantt chart keys - We missed the Dag Warning banner when cleaning up other banners. It is now merged into the dag import error to show errors and warnings together - Fixed console log error where FilterPill was nesting buttons - Added back a margin between filters and the dag card list that was lost when we get rid of the isFetching loader - Dag runs in a Dag Card were occasionally aligned to the top of the card, breaking the bar chart - Removed spinner on Dag Card for pending runs. The state badges are enough - Reduce HITL task requests that kept ending in 404s Warning banner before: After: Dag card before: After: Filter margin before: After: --- ##### Was generative AI tooling used to co-author this PR? - [X] Yes (please specify the tool below) Generated-by: Claude Code (Opus 5) following [the guidelines](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/contributing-docs/05_pull_requests.rst#gen-ai-assisted-contributions)

+import type { ReactNode } from "react";
+
+import { HStack, Text, VStack } from "@chakra-ui/react";
+import { FiAlertCircle, FiAlertTriangle } from "react-icons/fi";
+
+import type { StatusChipSeverity } from "src/components/StatusChip";
+
+type Props = {
+  /** The detail under the heading. Omit for a status that says all it has to say in its heading. */
+  readonly body?: ReactNode;
+  readonly heading: string;
+  readonly severity: Exclude<StatusChipSeverity, "info">;
+};
+
+/**
+ * One problem stated in a list of them: its severity in the icon and the colour of its text, its
+ * short form as the heading, the long form underneath. Coloured text rather than a filled block,
+ * so a list of these stays readable and a long traceback does not become a wall of colour.
+ */
+export const StatusMessage = ({ body, heading, severity }: Props) => (
+  <VStack align="start" gap={1} w="100%">
+    <HStack color={`fg.${severity}`} gap={2}>
+      {severity === "error" ? <FiAlertCircle /> : <FiAlertTriangle />}
+      <Text fontWeight="bold">{heading}</Text>
+    </HStack>
+    {body === undefined ? undefined : (
+      <Text color={`fg.${severity}`} fontSize="sm" whiteSpace="pre-wrap" wordBreak="break-word">
+        {body}
+      </Text>
+    )}
+  </VStack>
+);
